VM Opcodes Reference

PUSH val — push to stack
POP — remove top
ADD — pop 2, push sum
SUB — pop 2, push diff
MUL — pop 2, push product
DIV — pop 2, push quotient
MOD — pop 2, push modulo
EQ — pop 2, push 1 if equal
LT — pop 2, push 1 if less
GT — pop 2, push 1 if greater
STORE — pop key,val; save
LOAD — pop key; push value
DUP — duplicate top
SWAP — swap top 2
LOG — log top value
EMIT — emit event
HALT — stop execution

📡 Network Configuration

Add Verdis to Trust Wallet as a custom network:

📱 Quick Setup (3 steps):

  1. Open Trust Wallet → Settings → Networks → Add Custom Network
  2. Enter: Network Name: Verdis | RPC URL: http://localhost:3200/rpc | Chain ID: 909 | Symbol: VRS
  3. Import a wallet below using the private key → Your VRS balance appears!

💱 Trade VRS on the DEX:

  1. Go to the 💎 Token tab or 💱 DEX tab in this dashboard
  2. Select a trading pair (VRS/CARBON, VRS/ECO, VRS/TREE, VRS/GREEN, VRS/REDD, CARBON/ECO)
  3. Enter the amount to swap → click Swap
  4. The swap executes on-chain and is included in the next block (every 5 seconds)

🔑 Wallet Import

Import a Verdis wallet into Trust Wallet using the private key below. Since Verdis uses secp256k1 (same as Ethereum), the same private key works in both.

📋 Setup Instructions

Step 1: Open Trust Wallet → Settings → Networks → Add Custom Network

Step 2: Enter the Network Configuration above (use the Public RPC URL, Chain ID 909, Symbol VRS)

Step 3: Go to Settings → Wallets → Import Wallet → Private Key

Step 4: Paste the private key from one of your Verdis wallets above

Step 5: Your VRS balance will appear in Trust Wallet!
